about: The rules that hold the specification's text (SPEC1a): no history in a rule paragraph, one name per form, statuses generated from docs/spec/status.json. Each mutant breaks one rule and a residue test kills it.

mutants.name: spec1a-history-skips-a-file
mutants.from:
for _, name := range names {
		found[name] = hits(files[name])
mutants.to:
for _, name := range names[:len(names)-1] {
		found[name] = hits(files[name])
mutants.rule: A text rule reads every spec file: an allowlisted file it skipped would pass silently.

mutants.name: spec1a-status-by-hand-passes
mutants.rule: A Status paragraph is the ledger's text: one edited by hand is rewritten, never kept.

mutants.name: spec1a-designed-with-witness
mutants.rule: A part that names a witness test is built: it cannot stay designed.

mutants.name: spec1a-fenced-word-flagged
mutants.rule: Code in a fenced block is not prose: Go's words in a habit message stay.

mutants.name: residue-std-read-unlisted
mutants.rule: The standard library gets no special treatment: a new read of std membership in the compiler has no row of std-privileges.txt.

mutants.name: residue-name-through-constant
mutants.rule: A comparison with a std package path through a package-level constant is a comparison with the path.

mutants.name: residue-table-key
mutants.to:
var mutantTable = map[string]bool{"queue.Queue": true}

// typeOf is x's checked type.
mutants.rule: A table keyed by a std name is a decision by name.

mutants.name: residue-debt-grows
mutants.from: language	internal/sketch/lower/gocall.go:isOptionType	Option at the Go boundary	-
mutants.to: debt	internal/sketch/lower/gocall.go:isOptionType	Option at the Go boundary	NP6
mutants.rule: The debt list only shrinks: a row may not join it.

mutants.name: residue-scan-skips-package
mutants.rule: The rule reads every compiler package: a package left out of the scan would hide its reads.

mutants.name: spec1a-glossary-status-label
mutants.from: in a machine, the step graph
mutants.to: in a machine (designed), the step graph
mutants.rule: A GLOSSARY entry carries no status label; the status is in docs/spec/status.json.

mutants.name: embed-duplicate-ledger-anchor
mutants.rule: Every ledger edit applies exactly once at HEAD, including literal template edits.

mutants.name: ledger-killer-alias
mutants.rule: Every ledger killer names a test the mutant runner can run: DIR:Test, DIR[TAG]:Test, an ergo suite, or examples:PROGRAM.

mutants.name: ledger-killer-example-package
mutants.rule: An examples killer names a program (a directory of examples with an ergo.mod), not a package inside one.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-platform-dropped
mutants.rule: The closure sweep's std store builds for gobind.Platforms: its copy storePlatforms equals gobind's list, as sets. The edited file is a test file of another package, which this suite's coverage does not instrument.

mutants.name: g16fix2-gobind-platform-dropped
mutants.rule: A platform dropped from gobind.Platforms is dropped from the closure's storePlatforms too.

mutants.name: gs3-fast-lists-unnamed
mutants.rule: A fast-tier example program is named by a mutant ledger row as a killer; one no row names runs in the full tier only.

mutants.name: gs3-fast-drops-killer
mutants.rule: A default example program a ledger row names as a killer stays in the fast tier, so narrowing the tier loses no kill.

mutants.name: gs5-std-in-fast-tier
mutants.rule: internal/gobind's std-binding test, which compiles the standard library for both platforms, runs in the full tier only (needsBuild first).

mutants.name: cs11-map-borrow-allowed
mutants.rule: compiler/ keys no Map by a borrow.

mutants.name: cs11-map-record-allowed
mutants.rule: compiler/ keys no Map by a record it declares (a node, a type or a symbol as a value).

mutants.name: cs11-map-union-allowed
mutants.rule: compiler/ keys no Map by a union it declares.

mutants.name: cs11-map-id-allowed
mutants.rule: compiler/ keys no Map by a dense id: a per-id result is a dense side table.

mutants.name: cs11-map-import-unresolved
mutants.from: if q, ok := k.X.(*syntax.Ident); ok && folders[q.Name] != "" {
mutants.to: if q, ok := k.X.(*syntax.Ident); ok && folders[q.Name] != "" && false {
mutants.rule: A key named across an import of the module is judged by its declaration.

mutants.name: cs11-map-string-refused
mutants.rule: A type compiler/ defines over string (a path, a name) may key a Map.

mutants.name: s3a-map-dense-id-allowed
mutants.rule: compiler/ keys no Map by std dense's ID[K] or Opt[K]: the checker store's ids index side tables.

mutants.name: s3a-map-dense-opt-allowed
mutants.rule: An optional dense id (one word) is a dense id: it keys no Map in compiler/.

mutants.name: mn-lines-unjoined
mutants.rule: A comment's lines are read as one text: a mutant named on the line after the word mutant is still checked.

mutants.name: mn-prefix-unread
mutants.to: if prefix, ok := strings.CutSuffix(name, "*"); ok && false {
mutants.rule: A name ending in * names the ledger rows with that prefix (gs1-key-*), and only them.

mutants.name: tempdir-remove-ignored
mutants.rule: A test function that removes the temporary directory it made (os.RemoveAll of its variable, in a deferred closure too) is no leak.

mutants.name: tempdir-place-ignored
mutants.rule: Only a file made in the system temporary directory counts; one made under a test's own directory is that directory's.

mutants.name: tempdir-any-removal
mutants.rule: Removing some other directory does not remove the one the function made.

mutants.name: gs18-cmd-cache-kept
mutants.rule: cmd/ergo's tests remove the private cache they make in /tmp (68 GB of leaked directories, 2026-11-13).

mutants.name: ws9a-lane-script-calls-rift
mutants.rule: No run script runs Rift: a lane is removed with work rm.

mutants.name: ws9a-agents-says-use-rift
mutants.from: - Make isolated repository changes in a lane:
mutants.to: - Use Rift for isolated repository changes, in a lane:
mutants.rule: No tracked doc tells the run to use Rift.

mutants.name: ds-moved-hash-unchecked
mutants.rule: A path that moved at F keeps its tree at F, or is gone; an edit names the repository it moved to.

mutants.name: patch-hook-unlisted
mutants.rule: Every hunk of the IR compiler patch in a file Go already has is a line of toolchain/ir/hooks with its reason (MINIMAL FORK PATCH).

mutants.name: patch-hook-grown
mutants.from: +	otherInfo = ergoStub(m, pkg, info, noders, otherInfo)
mutants.to:
+	// grown
+	otherInfo = ergoStub(m, pkg, info, noders, otherInfo)
mutants.rule: A hook that grows past its line's count in toolchain/ir/hooks fails until its line says so: the changed lines in Go's own files are a tracked number.

mutants.name: view-without-inventory-line
mutants.rule: interop.md Foreign facts 8: BytesView is a line of the unsafe inventory.

mutants.name: toolchain-mygo-unpinned
mutants.rule: Every go.mod the repository tracks has the root's toolchain line (toolchain.Version, ported by toolchain/ir/lock), so `go test` in a nested module runs, and puts first on PATH, the release ergo's IR patch is ported to.

mutants.name: prelude-union-new-mention
mutants.rule: A lowering function the list does not hold that names the prelude's Option, Some or None fails the rule (ADT-NOPRIV: decide by shape, definition or law).

mutants.name: prelude-union-stale-row
mutants.rule: A row that counts more mentions than its function has is stale and fails, so a removed site takes its row with it and the list only shrinks.

mutants.name: prelude-field-read-unseen
mutants.rule: A prelude record's field the compiler reads by name (Value, In, Signal) is counted: a read the scan cannot see would not be guarded, so a row whose count it misses goes stale.

mutants.name: docs-unlisted-passes
mutants.rule: A tracked document with no row of testdata/docs.txt fails: a lane cannot add a document.

mutants.name: docs-dead-row-passes
mutants.rule: An exact row of testdata/docs.txt names a tracked document: a deleted file takes its row with it.

mutants.name: docs-exempt-widened
mutants.rule: Only the vendored corpus and testdata inputs are outside the document set: a document in any other folder needs a row.

mutants.name: spec-cite-missing-passes
mutants.rule: A source citation of a spec item that does not exist fails: a spec rewrite cannot drop an item a diagnostic prints.

mutants.name: spec-cite-any-heading
mutants.rule: A citation resolves only under the heading it names (or whose first words it names), not under any heading that has an item of that number.

mutants.name: spec-cite-fence-item
mutants.rule: A numbered line inside a fenced block is example text, not a spec item a citation can name.

mutants.name: spec-cite-stale-row-passes
mutants.rule: spec-citations-allow.txt is exact: a row whose citation resolves or is gone fails, so the list only shrinks.
